info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Leasing Item Update API
info.description: The Leasing Item Update API allows businesses to modify existing leasing item information to ensure accurate and up-to-date records. This endpoint enables users to update specific attributes of leasing items, facilitating better management of inventory and leasing contracts. Typical consumers include leasing administrators and finance teams who require real-time adjustments to leasing data. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline their leasing processes and improve operational efficiency.

patch.description: This endpoint allows users to update the details of a specific leasing item administration identified by its resource ID. Provide the necessary fields in the request body to modify the leasing item as required.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the leasing item identified by RES-100045. It allows client applications to send modifications to various attributes of the leasing item, ensuring that relevant data is submitted in a standardized JSON format.

200.description: The request was completed successfully, and the resource has been updated.
